-- TYPE MISMATCH ------------------------------------ main.fango

This argument is a number, but `greet` expects:

    String

4| main() = print (greet 30 "Ana")
                         ^^

    String

but `greet` expects:

    Int

4| main() = print (greet 30 "Ana")
                            ^^^^^
